title: Core: AS2 do-while loop
description: Test compilation of do-while: do { trace(i); i++; } while (i < 10). Verify ActionJump (0x99) at end of body looping back. Test do-while with break inside. Test do-while with continue. Test do-while where body always executes at least once (compile-time behavior only — no runtime). Verify the bytecode contains the loop structure.
